case_selection.counterparts: same question, condition and replicate in O and S; the arm's follow-off cell; shown without claiming they differ only in one link
case_selection.nature: outcome-stratified illustrations, not a representative sample or effect estimate

strata.a: accepted added-edge follow with first page text exposure (no earlier returned lines or snippet line), a `supported` same-variant direct label for the destination, and a final-answer citation of the destination whose cited lines intersect the lines this follow returned
strata.b: accepted added-edge follow whose destination page is not cited in the final answer
strata.c: accepted follow with an attribution-breaking missing or ambiguous record: edge class unknown, replay not verified, file or text identity false, offered menu unknown, a tier-2 destination label of identity_mismatch, never_judged or undetermined, or a supported destination whose spans are all unmappable

chain_t2_follow: ... of which the follow is the destination's first page text exposure
... and the destination label is supported (same variant, page bytes joined)
... and a located supporting span lies in the lines that follow returned
... and the final answer cites the destination
... and the cited lines intersect the lines that follow returned
definitions.chain_units: planned traces and unique question-destination pairs; follows are repeated observations within a question, never independent replications
definitions.legacy_landing: Sprint 20 follows_landing_on_support (all follow actions by name, verify-escalated positive qrels, common 105, mean per question)

novelty.first_page_text_exposure: first_returned_lines and no earlier snippet line of it

novelty.listed_by_prior_search: destination id in an earlier search's hits
novelty.new_lines_beyond_snippets: returned lines not returned before and not shown as snippets

definitions.opportunity: per accepted follow decision, the share of offered menu arcs that are added; reported beside the added share of uses, descriptively
definitions.success_landing: accepted follows whose destination label is supported under the page-byte join, same population and averaging
